context: Aoi cleans up a small beach with the cafe volunteer group.
purpose: Community volunteer engaging in environmental action.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ゴミ、こんなにあるとは。
lines.style: Quiet observation, slightly troubled. Warm tone underneath the concern. Pause after the dash, taking it in. Gentle exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ほんま、海きれいにしたい。
lines.en: Really, I want to clean up the ocean.
lines.style: Steady, grounded conviction. Warm Kansai lilt on 「ほんま」. Not performative — just simple resolve. Slight emphasis on 「きれいにしたい」.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 砂、踏むの気持ちいいね。
lines.en: Walking barefoot on the sand feels really good.
lines.style: Soft wonder. Voice slows down on the sensory moment. Noticing something small and genuine. Gentle, almost meditative pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こういう活動、続けたい。
lines.en: I want to keep doing activities like this.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Not rushed. The warmth of someone who means what he says. Slight firmness on 「続けたい」 — resolve without hardness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: We're all protecting the community together, aren't we.
lines.style: Soft realisation in the voice. Warm, slightly inspired. The tone of someone noticing something larger than the immediate moment. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Every small step matters, you know.
lines.style: Gentle philosophical weight. Warm Kansai undertone. Not lecturing — offering wisdom quietly. Slight pause before 「大事や」, letting the thought settle.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、参加できて嬉しい。
lines.en: Yeah, I'm really glad I could be part of this.
lines.style: Tender gratitude. Warm, genuine smile in the voice. Soft, unhurried. The relief of belonging to something meaningful. Quiet sincerity.
